answer: SELECT sitelabel, effective_power FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.sitetie) p.sitelabel, ROUND((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric / ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric + (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric)), 2) AS effective_power FROM plant_record r JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie JOIN electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey WHERE (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric + (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric <> 0 ORDER BY r.sitetie, r.snapts DESC) t ORDER BY effective_power DESC

SELECT LOWER(m.pnlkind) AS panel_kind, AVG(((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v')::numeric) / (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric) AS avg_voltage_degradation_factor FROM electrical_performance e JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = e.snaplink JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie JOIN panel_models m ON m.modkey = p.modhook WHERE (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_now_v')::numeric IS NOT NULL AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'iv_curve'->>'vmp_initial_v')::numeric > 0 GROUP BY LOWER(m.pnlkind) ORDER BY avg_voltage_degradation_factor DESC
SELECT SUM(m.degyrrate / 100.0 * 400000 * 50 * 15) AS total_lifetime_revenue_loss FROM plants p JOIN panel_models m ON m.modkey = p.modhook WHERE m.degyrrate * 20 > 14
note: ADR taken as the panel model's degyrrate (percent/yr, divided by 100); summed over plants via plants.modhook.

answer: SELECT AVG(o.maintcost / ((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.snapts - p.goliveon::timestamp)) / 3600.0) / o.mtbfh)) AS avg_mean_repair_cost FROM operational_metrics o JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = o.snapops JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie WHERE o.mtbfh > 0 AND (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.snapts - p.goliveon::timestamp)) / 3600.0) > 0 AND o.mttrh / (o.mtbfh + o.mttrh) > 0.05
note: No snapshot has MTTR/(MTBF+MTTR) > 0.05 (max 0.04), so this returns NULL.

answer: SELECT sitelabel, warrclaims FROM plants WHERE warrclaims > 2 AND LOWER(warrstate) = 'claimed' ORDER BY warrclaims DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.sitetie) AS plant_count FROM mechanical_condition m JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = m.snapmk WHERE LOWER(m.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'grounding_status') = 'failed' OR LOWER(m.mech_health_snapshot->'electrical_integrity'->>'bypass_diode_status') <> 'normal'

SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.maintcost / (17520.0 / o.mtbfh))::numeric) AS mean_repair_cost FROM operational_metrics o JOIN plant_record r ON r.snapkey = o.snapops JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = r.sitetie JOIN panel_models m ON m.modkey = p.modhook WHERE LOWER(m.pnlkind) = 'hjt' AND o.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND o.mtbfh > 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.sitetie) FROM plant_record r JOIN electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey JOIN operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey WHERE e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'performance_ratio' IS NOT NULL AND o.mtbfh IS NOT NULL AND o.mttrh IS NOT NULL AND o.mtbfh + o.mttrh > 0 AND (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'performance_ratio')::numeric < 0.75 AND 1 - o.mttrh / (o.mtbfh + o.mttrh) < 0.95
note: No snapshot has computed availability < 0.95; returns 0.

answer: SELECT (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric / ((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_now_w')::numeric + (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'power'->>'power_loss_w')::numeric)) AS effective_power_w FROM electrical_performance e WHERE UPPER(e.snaplink) = 'PV945724'
